title: Side B
style: Square vinyl record album cover, flat full-bleed artwork seen straight on (no vinyl disc, no sleeve edge, no mockup, no shadow), print-ready. The artwork runs right to all four edges, with no white border, frame or margin. Bold, minimal, eye-catching graphic design with confident typography. The only words on it are the artist name and the album title given here, spelled exactly. No other text, no barcode, no watermark.
